alex-customer: Hi, noticed our March invoice total (EUR) doesn't match the usage dashboard. Off by €0.47. Dashboard shows EUR 4,123.52, invoice is EUR 4,123.99. Can you explain?
elaine-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the invoice id and the billable project id?
alex-customer: invoice INV-2026-00321, project: acme-payments-prod. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/INV-2026-00321.png
elaine-support: Thanks. Tagging billing team. @mike-billing can you take a look? :eyes:
mike-billing: Looking. Initial hypothesis: currency conversion / per-line rounding mismatch. Do we know if Acme had mixed-currency usage (USD requests billed to EUR account)?
alex-customer: All usage in March is US-region but account currency is EUR. We saw small per-request token costs in USD on the usage export.
mike-billing: OK. Two common causes: 1) per-request rounding when converting token cost to EUR then summing, vs 2) summing USD raw costs then converting final total to EUR. Those produce micro-euro deltas.
sophie-engr: Also metering currently writes token_cost with 4 decimal precision in cents to the usage table for speed. Invoice generator used to do per-line currency conversion + round to cents. That double-rounding can create leftover pennies when aggregated.
elaine-support: Can you show a minimal repro calculation for the delta?
mike-billing: Sure. Example from the export (simplified):
```
# three requests in USD
req1: 0.0345 USD
req2: 0.0217 USD
req3: 0.0123 USD
sum USD = 0.0685 USD
USD->EUR rate = 0.92
A) convert per-request then round to cents:
  req1_EUR = round(0.0345 * 0.92, 2) = round(0.03174, 2) = 0.03
  req2_EUR = round(0.0217 * 0.92, 2) = round(0.019964, 2) = 0.02
  req3_EUR = round(0.0123 * 0.92, 2) = round(0.011316, 2) = 0.01
  total_A = 0.06 EUR
B) sum USD then convert and round:
  total_USD = 0.0685
  total_EUR = round(0.0685 * 0.92, 2) = round(0.06302, 2) = 0.06 EUR
In this tiny example no delta, but with many lines the integer rounding accumulates differently.

Now case with a slightly different distribution yields delta:
```
reqs USD: [0.0333, 0.0333, 0.0333]
per-line convert: round(0.0306,2)+round(0.0306,2)+round(0.0306,2) = 0.03+0.03+0.03=0.09
sum then convert: round(0.0999*0.92,2)=round(0.091908,2)=0.09 => still same
But with truncation to cents at intermediate steps used in our pipeline we sometimes truncate rather than round, and also tax (VAT) applied per-line vs on aggregate changes result.
```

mike-billing: In this account's raw usage export I see ~12,437 USD cents spread over 13k requests; conversion + VAT applied per-line in invoice generator. That pattern tends to create ~€0.40-0.60 deltas.

elaine-support: Thanks. Can we re-run invoice calc with high precision arithmetic and aggregate before any rounding to confirm?
sophie-engr: Yes. Quick repro steps I ran locally:
```
1) download usage export from production: /exports/usage_acme_payments_2026-03.csv
2) load into python with Decimal at 10 decimal places
3) sum raw USD cost_per_request into total_raw_usd
4) convert once to EUR: total_eur = round(total_raw_usd * rate, 2)
5) compute VAT on aggregated total, round at final step
```
Result: aggregated_total_eur = 4123.52 (matches dashboard export). Current invoice generator (per-line convert+VAT) -> 4123.99.
```

mike-billing: Root cause summary: invoice code path applies currency conversion and VAT per line using stored truncated per-request values (4-decimal precision) which loses sub-cent precision. Solution options: A) change invoice generator to recompute from raw usage with high-precision decimals and only round at final line, B) keep current invoice but add a single rounding-adjustment line item to reconcile, C) add a one-time credit for the difference for affected customers.

elaine-support: For Acme specifically they prefer corrected invoice + credit if needed. I'll offer a manual corrected invoice while eng implements fix. @mike-billing can you create a corrected invoice?
mike-billing: I'll generate a corrected invoice (INV-2026-00321-CORR) by re-running aggregation on exports with 8 decimal precision and applying VAT at final step. Also filing bug: BILL-4573 (invoice rounding/currency conversion).

elaine-support: Ticket recorded, escalation -> BILL-4573. Please add repro steps and example export to the ticket.
mike-billing: Added. Also queued a small migration: store raw_cost_usd with 8 decimal places in usage table (PR in progress).
sophie-engr: Quick note: billing-bot will emit an automated webhook when corrected invoice is issued.
billing-bot: Automated: corrected invoice INV-2026-00321-CORR created, delta = -0.47 EUR (credit). Reference: BILL-4573.
alex-customer: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will confirm once we get the corrected invoice.
elaine-support: We will also issue a credit for €0.47 to your account and re-send the invoice. ETA: EOD today. :thumbsup:
mike-billing: Followup actions: 1) apply code fix to invoice generator to aggregate before currency conversion (PR #5248), 2) migration to store higher-precision usage values, 3) add an automated reconciliation check that flags > €0.10 drift between dashboard export and invoice.
sophie-engr: I'll review PR #5248 and schedule a canary deploy to staging.
elaine-support: Closing loop once credit + corrected invoice are delivered and BILL-4573 has description + repro. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
